description: This file contains functions for managing Drupal database updates, including schema requirement checks, dependency resolution, and update execution logic.

methods.name: update_system_schema_requirements
methods.description: Checks if the system schema version meets the minimum requirement and returns the status.

methods.name: update_check_requirements
methods.description: Checks all module requirements and fixes missing schema info.

methods.name: _update_fix_missing_schema
methods.description: Detects and fixes modules with missing schema version info, updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: update_do_one
methods.description: Performs a single module update, handling success, failure, and dependency management.

methods.name: update_invoke_post_update
methods.description: Executes a post-update hook function for a module.

methods.name: update_get_update_list
methods.description: Returns a list of pending updates for modules, including warnings and descriptions.

methods.name: update_resolve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves and orders update functions based on dependencies, marking missing or disallowed updates.

methods.name: update_get_update_function_list
methods.description: Generates an ordered list of update functions for specified modules.

methods.name: update_build_dependency_graph
methods.description: Builds a dependency graph of update functions based on order and explicit dependencies.

methods.name: update_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific module update is missing or unavailable.

methods.name: update_already_performed
methods.description: Checks if a specific update has already been applied based on the installed version.

methods.name: update_retrieve_dependencies
methods.description: Invokes hook_update_dependencies() in all installed modules to gather dependencies.
